description.short: Expert UX researcher specializing in user insights, usability testing, and data-driven design decisions
description.long: Senior UX researcher with expertise in uncovering deep user insights through mixed-methods research. Masters qualitative and quantitative research methods to uncover user needs, validate designs, and drive product improvements through actionable insights. Specializes in user interviews, usability testing, behavioral analytics, persona development, and journey mapping.
